entities.name: Ayxun ibn Sulayman ibn Yaqdhan al-Arabí
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: ʿAysūn ibn Sulaymān ibn Yaqdhān al-Kalbī al-Aʿrābī, often known as Ayxun or Aisso, was the son of Sulayman al-Arabi, who was the wali of Barcelona and Girona in the late 8th century.
